comments.content:
Yes, we need to mint more gnosis [UUSD](https://gnosisscan.io/address/0xC6ed4f520f6A4e4DC27273509239b7F8A68d2068). As far as I understand right now [this](https://gnosisscan.io/address/0x9051eDa96dB419c967189F4Ac303a290F3327680) address is used for payouts.
What to do:
1. UUSD minting is not available right now since UUSD price is `$1.0012` and min mint threshold is `$1.01` so we need to adjust thresholds:
  a) Open https://louper.dev/diamond/0xed3084c98148e2528dadcb53c56352e549c488fa
  b) Find out the `setPriceThresholds` method in the `UbiquityPoolFacet`
  c) Set new price thresholds `1000000` both for mint and redeem
  d) At this point I'll be able to mint some UUSD for bridging
2. Now we need to mint UUSD:
  a) Open https://louper.dev/diamond/0xed3084c98148e2528dadcb53c56352e549c488fa
  b) Find out the `mintDollar` method in the `UbiquityPoolFacet`
  c) If you want to mint 5000 UUSD for 5000 LUSD then you need to set these parameters:
    - `collateralIndex`: `0`
    - `dollarAmount`: `5000000000000000000000` (5000 in wei)
    - `dollarOutMin`: `4900000000000000000000` (4900 in wei)
    - `maxCollateralIn`: `5100000000000000000000` (5100 in wei)
    - `maxGovernanceIn`: `0`
    - `isOneToOne`: `true` (`true` means we provide only LUSD for collateral without UBQ tokens)
3. Use https://bridge.gnosischain.com/ to bridge UUSD to gnosis
4. Then you'll have to call `setPriceThresholds` again and set values back (`1010000` for mint price threshold, `990000` for redeem price threshold)
5. Approve [permit2 contract](https://gnosisscan.io/address/0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3) to spend [UUSD](https://gnosisscan.io/address/0xC6ed4f520f6A4e4DC27273509239b7F8A68d2068) tokens.

@0x4007 
I think it's fine to keep both mint and redeem thresholds to be `1000000`, I don't think it affects the protocol too much. There were no specific issues regarding the thresholds in the Sherlock audit.
Right now collateral ratio is set to 95%. It means that on minting user has 2 options:
1. Mint 1 UUSD in exchange for `$0.95` LUSD and `$0.05` UBQ
2. Mint 1 UUSD in exchange for `$1.00` LUSD
So a "5% UBQ discount" is enabled right now.

Yes, example:
1. User mints 100 UUSD and provides: `$0.95` LUSD + `$0.05` UBQ
2. After some time user redeems 100 UUSD and gets back: `$0.95` LUSD + `$0.05` UBQ
